_comment: Mono waveform band convention (issue #12585). The backend declares kind 'mono' and repeats one real PWAV/PWV3 envelope under low/mid/high; the browser paints the per-point max across the three as one mono-colour envelope. tests/webui/test_mono_waveform_band_convention.py proves the backend side; tests/unit/mono-waveform-band-convention.test.mjs proves the browser side.
